fullDescription: Quiet monochrome graphite-on-paper SaaS landing in Inter, no color accent at all, anchored by a single centered CTA card framed by four corner registration-mark ticks, with a hairline eyebrow pill, a tight headline, one dark graphite primary pill beside a hairline ghost, and a hairline-divided trust line on a faint dotted-grain canvas.

structured.summary: A quiet, monochrome graphite-on-paper SaaS landing whose star is a single centered CTA framed by registration marks, the kind of restrained design-tool moment that lets the headline and one button carry everything. It reads as a real page top to bottom: a frosted scrim sticky nav (a near-black graphite diamonds-four logo tile + 'Anvil' wordmark, five muted center links, a 'Log in' text link, a small dark 'Start designing' pill), then the full-bleed CTA section on a warm paper field with a faint dotted grain and soft top/bottom edge fades. The CTA is a max-w-760px quiet card (rounded-20px, near-transparent paper, a hairline border, a long soft inset+drop shadow) framed by four small corner registration ticks sitting just outside it, so it reads as a design artifact on a canvas. Inside, centered: a rounded-full hairline 'From prompt to pixel' eyebrow pill with a tiny pulsing graphite dot, a big Inter 560 headline 'Stop staring at the blank canvas.' (the last phrase carries a faint platinum gradient underline), a muted subhead, a single dark graphite primary pill 'Start designing free' with an arrow beside a quiet hairline-outline ghost 'Watch the canvas', and a three-item hairline-divided trust line (No credit card / Works in your coding agent / 57k designers and builders). The page closes on a full-bleed dark graphite footer (paper logo, four link columns, copyright, social icons, an 'All systems normal' status dot).

style.description: A restrained, premium, monochrome design-tool aesthetic where a warm paper field and a single near-black graphite ink do all the work, with no color accent at all. The palette is grayscale-warm: a paper page #fbfbfa, near-black graphite ink #1c1c1e (with graphite shades 950 #1c1c1e, 900 #222224, 850 #28282b, 800 #2c2c2e) for text/buttons/footer, and a soft platinum #c7c7cc used only as a faint gradient underline hairline. Everything else is the same ink at low opacity (text at /70, /72, /80, borders at rgba(28,28,30,0.07-0.10), dividers at /12). There is no second hue: hierarchy comes entirely from ink-opacity steps, hairline borders, and soft shadow depth. One font does everything: Inter (weights 400-680 with OpenType features cv05, ss01, cv11 on), set tight with custom negative tracking (.tight -0.035em, .tighter -0.045em), the headline at weight 560 and a near-1.0 line-height. The look is quiet and crafted: a very faint radial dot grain on the canvas (rgba(28,28,30,0.045) dots at 26px), soft paper-to-transparent edge fades top and bottom of the section, a frosted scrim nav (paper/72 with saturate(140%) blur(10px)), generous rounding (a rounded-full eyebrow + buttons, a rounded-20px CTA card), and a signature design-tool flourish: four small corner registration-mark ticks framing the CTA card like artwork on a canvas. The single primary button is a near-black graphite pill that lifts 1px with a soft shadow on hover; the secondary is a transparent hairline ghost that just darkens its border. The mood is calm, confident and expensive, an infinite-canvas AI design agent that trusts one clear action and a lot of quiet space rather than color or noise.
style.prompt: Build a quiet monochrome graphite-on-paper SaaS landing whose anchor is a single centered CTA framed by registration marks. Use NO color accent at all: a paper page bg #fbfbfa, near-black graphite ink #1c1c1e for all text/buttons/footer (graphite shades 950 #1c1c1e, 900 #222224, 850 #28282b, 800 #2c2c2e), and a soft platinum #c7c7cc only as a faint gradient underline. Everything else is that same ink at low opacity (body text-graphite-950/70 and /72, borders .hairline rgba(28,28,30,0.10) and .hairline-soft rgba(28,28,30,0.07), dividers bg-graphite-950/12). Hierarchy is opacity + hairlines + soft shadow only, never a second hue. One Google font: Inter (weights 400;420;460;500;560;600;680) for everything, with font-feature-settings 'cv05' 1, 'ss01' 1, 'cv11' 1 and custom tight tracking utilities (.tight letter-spacing -0.035em, .tighter -0.045em); the headline is font-[560] text-[40px] sm:text-[58px] leading-[1.03] .tighter, body is font-[420] text-[15.5px] sm:text-[17px] text-graphite-950/70. Texture is whisper-quiet: a .grain radial-gradient(rgba(28,28,30,0.045) 1px, transparent 1px) at 26px 26px with -13px offset on the section, plus soft pointer-events-none paper-to-transparent edge fades (h-24 bg-gradient-to-b from-paper top, bg-gradient-to-t bottom). Nav is a frosted .scrim (background rgba(251,251,250,0.72); backdrop-filter saturate(140%) blur(10px)) sticky bar with a border-b .hairline-soft. The STAR is a centered CTA card: a relative max-w-[760px] wrapper holding a rounded-[20px] border .hairline-soft bg-paper/40 card with generous px-7 sm:px-14 py-14 sm:py-[88px] text-center, and a signature soft shadow box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6) inset, 0 40px 80px -50px rgba(28,28,30,0.16); framed by four absolutely-positioned 13px corner registration ticks (.tick, border-color rgba(28,28,30,0.28)) inset -7px outside each corner with only the two relevant borders showing. Inside: a rounded-full .hairline eyebrow pill (bg-paper, a tiny pulsing graphite dot, 11.5px uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-graphite-950/70 'From prompt to pixel'); the headline with a faint platinum gradient-underline hairline on the last phrase (an absolute -bottom-1 h-px w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-platinum to-transparent); a muted subhead; a single primary graphite pill (rounded-full bg-graphite-950 px-7 py-[14px] text-[15px] font-[500] text-paper, ring-1 ring-inset ring-platinum/20, a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold, .btn-primary hover lifts translateY(-1px) with box-shadow 0 10px 28px -10px rgba(28,28,30,0.45)) beside a quiet hairline ghost (rounded-full border .hairline bg-transparent text-graphite-950/80, a ph:play-circle, .btn-ghost hover just darkens the border); a hairline-divided trust line of three items (ph:check-circle, ph:terminal-window, ph:users-three) separated by h-3 w-px bg-graphite-950/12 dividers. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph). Antialiased, smooth-scroll, text-rendering optimizeLegibility, a graphite ::selection. Keep it calm, premium and monochrome: one ink, lots of quiet space, hairlines and soft shadows only, exactly one clear primary action. No em-dashes in copy.
style.prompt_short: Quiet monochrome graphite-on-paper SaaS landing in Inter, no color accent at all (paper #fbfbfa + graphite ink #1c1c1e + a faint platinum underline). Anchored by a single centered CTA card framed by four corner registration-mark ticks, with a hairline eyebrow pill, a tight headline, one dark graphite primary pill beside a hairline ghost, and a hairline-divided trust line, on a faint dotted-grain canvas with soft edge fades.

layout_and_structure.description: A real framed landing page read as a calm vertical stack: a frosted sticky nav, a full-bleed paper CTA section that fills most of the viewport (min-h-[78vh]) and centers a single registration-mark-framed CTA card, then a full-bleed dark graphite footer. The nav, CTA, and footer all share a centered mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 sm:px-8 column, while the CTA card itself narrows to max-w-[760px] and its subhead/trust copy to max-w-[470px]. It reflows cleanly to one column on mobile: the nav center links and 'Log in' hide (logo + 'Start designing' pill remain), the headline line-break and the trust-line vertical dividers hide (hidden sm:block / hidden sm:inline), the two CTA buttons stack full-width (flex-col -> sm:flex-row, w-full -> sm:w-auto), the card padding tightens (px-7 py-14 -> sm:px-14 sm:py-[88px]), the trust line wraps, and the footer grid goes from 12-col to 2-col with the bottom bar stacking.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50 w-full) with a frosted .scrim background (rgba(251,251,250,0.72); backdrop-filter saturate(140%) blur(10px)) and a border-b .hairline-soft. Inside a mx-auto flex max-w-[1180px] items-center justify-between px-6 sm:px-8 h-16 nav: LEFT = a brand link (flex items-center gap-2.5) with a 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-[9px] bg-graphite-950 text-paper tile (shadow-sm, grid place-items-center) holding a 15px ph:diamonds-four-fill, beside a 16px font-[600] .tighter 'Anvil' wordmark; CENTER (hidden md:flex, gap-8, 13.5px font-[460] text-graphite-950/70) = five .nav-link links 'Canvas / Library / Pricing / Docs / Changelog' that darken to text-ink on hover; RIGHT (flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-3) = a 'Log in' text link (hidden sm:inline, 13.5px font-[460] text-graphite-950/70 px-2) and a small rounded-full bg-graphite-950 px-4 py-[7px] 13.5px font-[500] text-paper 'Start designing' .btn-primary pill linking to #cta.

prompts.partPt: Full-bleed paper Chamada Final para Ação section frame
prompts.prompt: A relative .grain section (id='cta') with border-b .hairline and overflow-hidden, on the paper field. Two pointer-events-none soft edge fades seat the section: an absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-b from-paper to-transparent, and an absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-paper to-transparent. Inside a relative mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 sm:px-8, a flex min-h-[78vh] flex-col items-center justify-center py-28 sm:py-36 wrapper centers the CTA so it fills most of the viewport with generous quiet space around it. The .grain is a faint radial-gradient(rgba(28,28,30,0.045) 1px, transparent 1px) tiled at 26px 26px with a -13px -13px offset, giving the canvas a barely-there dotted paper texture.

prompts.partPt: THE STAR: registration-mark-framed Chamada Final para Ação card
prompts.prompt: Centered in the section, a relative w-full max-w-[760px] wrapper. Four corner registration-mark ticks sit just OUTSIDE the card as a design-tool flourish: four .tick spans (position absolute, 13px square, border-color rgba(28,28,30,0.28)) inset -7px past each corner, each showing only its two relevant borders, e.g. top-left -left-[7px] -top-[7px] border-l border-t, top-right -right-[7px] -top-[7px] border-r border-t, and the two bottom corners mirrored with border-b. Inside sits the card itself: a rounded-[20px] border .hairline-soft bg-paper/40 px-7 sm:px-14 py-14 sm:py-[88px] text-center block with a signature soft shadow box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6) inset, 0 40px 80px -50px rgba(28,28,30,0.16). All CTA content stacks centered inside this card.

At the top of the card, a mb-8 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border .hairline bg-paper px-3 py-1 eyebrow pill (shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(28,28,30,0.04)) with a tiny pulsing graphite status dot (a relative h-1.5 w-1.5 with an absolute -inset-[3px] rounded-full bg-graphite-950/10 halo behind a solid bg-graphite-950 dot) and an 11.5px font-[500] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-graphite-950/70 'From prompt to pixel'. Then the headline: a .tighter font-[560] text-[40px] sm:text-[58px] leading-[1.03] text-ink h1 reading 'Stop staring at' + a hidden sm:block
+ 'the ' + a relative whitespace-nowrap 'blank canvas.' whose last phrase carries a faint platinum gradient underline (an absolute -bottom-1 left-0 h-px w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-platinum to-transparent).

Below the headline, a mx-auto mt-6 max-w-[470px] .tight font-[420] text-[15.5px] sm:text-[17px] leading-relaxed text-graphite-950/70 subhead, centered: 'Describe the screen. Anvil drafts the UI, components, and full flows on an infinite canvas. Ship the design today.' Kept short and calm, no em-dashes.

A mt-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 button row that becomes sm:flex-row sm:gap-4. PRIMARY (one clear action) = a .btn-primary inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-graphite-950 px-7 py-[14px] text-[15px] font-[500] text-paper pill, w-full sm:w-auto, with a ring-1 ring-inset ring-platinum/20, the label 'Start designing free', and a trailing 17px ph:arrow-right-bold at opacity-80; hover lifts translateY(-1px) with box-shadow 0 10px 28px -10px rgba(28,28,30,0.45). SECONDARY (quiet) = a .btn-ghost inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border .hairline bg-transparent px-7 py-[14px] text-[15px] font-[460] text-graphite-950/80 pill, w-full sm:w-auto, with a leading 17px ph:play-circle at opacity-70 and 'Watch the canvas'; hover just darkens the border to rgba(28,28,30,0.32) with a faint bg tint. Only the primary is filled, so the single intended action is unmistakable.

Below the buttons, a mt-11 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 .tight font-[440] text-[12.5px] text-graphite-950/72 trust line of three inline-flex items, each with a leading 14px text-graphite-950/70 Phosphor icon: ph:check-circle 'No credit card', ph:terminal-window 'Works in your coding agent', ph:users-three '57k designers & builders'. Between the items sit two hidden-on-mobile vertical hairline dividers (hidden sm:inline h-3 w-px bg-graphite-950/12). On mobile the dividers hide and the items wrap.

A footer with bg-graphite-950 text-paper (the page's only large dark block). Inside mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 sm:px-8 py-16 sm:py-20: a grid grid-cols-2 gap-10 sm:grid-cols-12 sm:gap-8. BRAND col (col-span-2 sm:col-span-4) = an inverted brand mark (a 28px rounded-[9px] bg-paper text-graphite-950 tile with a 15px ph:diamonds-four-fill + a 16px font-[600] .tighter 'Anvil'), a mt-5 max-w-[230px] 13.5px text-platinum/55 .tight blurb 'The AI design agent. Idea to shippable UI, on an infinite canvas.', and a mt-6 row of three 32px rounded-full border-white/12 social icon links (ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo) that brighten to text-paper on hover. Then three link columns (sm:col-span-2, the first sm:col-start-7) 'Product / Library / Company', each a 12px font-[560] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-platinum/45 heading over a mt-4 space-y-2.5 list of 13.5px text-platinum/65 links that hover to text-paper. A mt-14 border-t border-white/10 pt-7 bottom bar (flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-between) holds a 12.5px text-platinum/45 'Copyright 2026 Anvil Labs. All rights reserved.' on the left and, on the right, a flex gap-6 12.5px row of 'Privacy', 'Terms', and an 'All systems normal' link with a small pulsing platinum status dot.

special_ui_components.prompt: The signature design-tool flourish: a centered CTA card framed by four small corner registration-mark ticks, so the call to action reads as an artwork on a canvas. The card is a relative max-w-[760px] rounded-[20px] border .hairline-soft (rgba(28,28,30,0.07)) bg-paper/40 px-7 sm:px-14 py-14 sm:py-[88px] text-center block with a soft signature shadow (box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6) inset for a top sheen, 0 40px 80px -50px rgba(28,28,30,0.16) for a long faint drop). The frame is four absolutely-positioned .tick spans (13px square, border-color rgba(28,28,30,0.28)) inset -7px just OUTSIDE each corner, each rendering only its two relevant borders (border-l+border-t at top-left, border-r+border-t at top-right, border-l+border-b at bottom-left, border-r+border-b at bottom-right), so they read as crop/registration marks rather than a full second border.

One clear action, expressed as a strict primary/secondary pair where only the primary is filled. PRIMARY = a near-black graphite pill .btn-primary: rounded-full bg-graphite-950 (#1c1c1e) px-7 py-[14px] text-[15px] font-[500] text-paper, with a ring-1 ring-inset ring-platinum/20 hairline edge and a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold at opacity-80; on hover it lifts (transform translateY(-1px)) and casts a soft shadow (box-shadow 0 10px 28px -10px rgba(28,28,30,0.45)) over a .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) transition. SECONDARY = a transparent hairline ghost .btn-ghost: rounded-full border .hairline bg-transparent px-7 py-[14px] text-[15px] font-[460] text-graphite-950/80 with a leading ph:play-circle at opacity-70; on hover it only deepens its border to rgba(28,28,30,0.32) and adds a faint rgba(28,28,30,0.025) tint. The contrast (solid dark vs hairline ghost) makes the intended action unmistakable without any color.

A tiny monochrome status-dot motif that appears in the eyebrow pill and the footer 'All systems normal' link: a relative flex h-1.5 w-1.5 holding a solid dot (the eyebrow uses bg-graphite-950, the footer bg-platinum) with an absolute -inset-[3px] rounded-full soft halo behind it (bg-graphite-950/10 in the eyebrow, bg-platinum/15 in the footer). It reads as a live/active indicator entirely in the grayscale palette, no green, reinforcing the calm monochrome system.

A translucent sticky header (sticky top-0 z-50) using a .scrim utility (background rgba(251,251,250,0.72); backdrop-filter saturate(140%) blur(10px); -webkit- prefixed) over the paper field with a border-b .hairline-soft, so paper content shows softly through on scroll. It carries a graphite logo tile + 'Anvil' wordmark on the left, muted center links, and a small solid 'Start designing' pill on the right, all in the same monochrome ink-opacity system as the rest of the page.

The page's only near-accent: a single faint underline hairline under the last headline phrase ('blank canvas.'). It is an absolute -bottom-1 left-0 h-px w-full element with bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-platinum (#c7c7cc) to-transparent, on a relative whitespace-nowrap span so it tracks the phrase and fades out at both ends. It adds a whisper of emphasis without introducing any color, staying inside the grayscale palette.

The CTA section gets its quiet 'canvas' feel from two whisper-quiet textures: a .grain background = radial-gradient(rgba(28,28,30,0.045) 1px, transparent 1px) tiled at 26px 26px with a background-position -13px -13px, giving a barely-visible dotted paper texture; plus two pointer-events-none paper-to-transparent edge fades (an absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-b from-paper to-transparent and a mirrored bottom h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-paper) that seat the bordered section softly into the page above and below it. Together they make the empty space feel intentional rather than blank.

structured.special_notes: Palette is strictly monochrome-warm with NO color accent: paper #fbfbfa (page bg), graphite ink #1c1c1e (all text/buttons/footer; graphite shades 950 #1c1c1e, 900 #222224, 850 #28282b, 800 #2c2c2e), platinum #c7c7cc used only as a faint gradient underline and as inverted footer text/social. Everything else is the same ink at low opacity (text /70 /72 /80, borders .hairline rgba(28,28,30,0.10) and .hairline-soft rgba(28,28,30,0.07), dividers /12). Hierarchy is opacity + hairlines + soft shadow only, never a second hue. One Google font: Inter (weights 400;420;460;500;560;600;680) for everything, with font-feature-settings 'cv05' 1, 'ss01' 1, 'cv11' 1 and custom tight tracking (.tight -0.035em, .tighter -0.045em); the headline is font-[560]40/58px leading-[1.03] .tighter, body font-[420] 15.5/17px text-graphite-950/70. Icons are Iconify Phosphor: ph:diamonds-four-fill (logo, nav + footer), ph:arrow-right-bold (primary button), ph:play-circle (ghost button), ph:check-circle + ph:terminal-window + ph:users-three (trust line), ph:x-logo / ph:github-logo / ph:discord-logo (footer social). Custom utilities carry the look: .grain (radial dot texture at 26px), .hairline / .hairline-soft (the two border opacities), .scrim (frosted nav, saturate(140%) blur(10px) over paper/72), .tick (the 13px corner registration marks, border rgba(28,28,30,0.28)), .btn-primary (translateY(-1px) lift + soft shadow on hover over a .18s cubic-bezier), .btn-ghost (border-darken on hover), .nav-link (color darken on hover); plus the signature CTA-card shadow box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6) inset, 0 40px 80px -50px rgba(28,28,30,0.16) and a graphite ::selection (#1c1c1e on #fbfbfa). The signature language is a single centered CTA card framed by four corner registration-mark ticks on a faint dotted-grain paper canvas with soft edge fades, exactly one filled primary action beside a hairline ghost, and a full-bleed dark graphite footer as the only large dark block. To transfer the STYLE: keep paper + a single graphite ink + a faint platinum underline (no second color), the one tight Inter font with its OpenType features and negative tracking, hierarchy from ink-opacity + hairlines + soft shadow only, the dotted-grain canvas, the frosted scrim nav, and the calm generous quiet space. To transfer the LAYOUT: keep the framed stack (frosted sticky nav -> full-bleed min-h-[78vh] paper CTA section with soft edge fades, centering a max-w-[760px] registration-mark-framed CTA card: eyebrow pill -> tight headline with platinum underline -> subhead -> single graphite primary pill + hairline ghost -> hairline-divided 3-item trust line -> full-bleed dark graphite footer with brand blurb, three link columns, and a status-dot bottom bar). All copy avoids em-dashes; exactly one clear primary action.
